jobs.description:
Project Assistant

NTU International is a leading international consulting firm providing programme management and advisory services for development projects worldwide. For almost three decades, NTU has been delivering sustainable development projects and advisory services within engineering, policy, economics, and social fields. With more than 1.100 international projects and studies already completed, and more than 15 project offices around the world, we have established ourselves as a leading consulting company. With the expansion of international activities and clients, NTU’s project pipeline and opportunities have grown significantly, therefore, we are looking for a motivated and result oriented individual, who is interested in experiencing our culture, intensive business environment, challenges as well as being part of our international success.

Key Responsibilities:

·       Provide administrative and clerical support to Project Managers and project teams in the implementation of EU-funded projects.

·       Assist with the preparation, formatting and processing of project documentation, reports, meeting minutes, presentations and other project-related materials, following established templates and instructions.

·       Maintain and update project files, databases, records and document management systems in accordance with internal procedures.

·       Support the organisation of project meetings, workshops, training sessions and other project activities, including scheduling, invitations, logistics and follow-up.

·       Assist with communication and correspondence with project partners, experts, beneficiaries and other stakeholders.

·       Monitor administrative deadlines and follow up on project documentation and information requests.

·       Collect, organise and verify project-related information and supporting documents for review by the responsible Project Managers.

·       Perform other administrative and coordination tasks related to project implementation.

Qualifications and skills:

·       Master’s degree in International Relations, International Business, or a related field.

·       Previous experience in administrative support, project assistance in an international working environment.

·       Good time-management skills and ability to meet deadlines.

·       Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.

·       Ability to work independently on assignments while recognising when guidance or approval is required.

·       A cooperative and service-oriented approach, with the ability to work effectively as part of an international project team.

·       Familiarity with EU-funded programmes, project documentation and administrative procedures is an advantage.

Language and skills:

·       English: C2 – Full professional proficiency (mandatory).

 Other information:

If you are interested in this position, please send your CV under the heading “Project Assistant” address it to Mrs. Vaida Cerneckyte-Larsen, e-mail. vac@ntu.eu. Please also make sure that you include one or more telephone numbers.

Only selected candidates will be contacted.

jobs.occupation: Site Manager – new biogas plants in Denmark and abroad
jobs.description:
Site Manager – new biogas plants in Denmark and abroad

Bigadan is built by people with deep professional expertise and a shared ambition: to create the circular energy solutions of the future. We have been building biogas plants for more than 40 years, in Denmark and abroad, and the coming years are busy. We have expansion and greenfield projects lined up in Denmark and Scandinavia, plus support projects for our clients in Germany and the UK. That is why we are looking for an experienced Site Manager for our Projects team.

Anywhere from 10 to 50+ people from different contractors on site, all needing to deliver at the same time. You are the one holding it all together. And when you hand over, you leave behind a plant that produces biogas for decades.

The role

You lead the site day to day from ground-breaking through commissioning and handover to operations. The people on site are mainly contractors in civil, mechanical, electrical, piping and process works. You report formally to Head of Projects Luke Morris, while Head of Site Managers Stefan Wussow is your manager in day-to-day operations. You work closely with the individual Project Managers and the Site team.

You spend around 80% of your time on site and 20% in the office. Our construction site office and workshop are based in Husum, Germany. Ideally, we would like you to be based in southern Denmark near Kliplev or Husum, but as the role involves a lot of travel, we are recruiting across Denmark and northern Germany. Our projects are spread across Denmark and abroad, including Sweden, Germany, Finland and the UK.

We expect you to be ready for periods of 3–4 weeks living near the site. Employment can be in Denmark or in Germany.

What you do

Site leadership. You coordinate daily activities and contractor progress, plan access, deliveries and lifting operations, and solve problems before they become delays.

Safety. You lead site inspections and toolbox talks and approve risk assessments and method statements. You set the standard on site.

Quality and documentation. You make sure the work follows drawings and specifications, including welding, and keep track of inspections and documentation.

Handover. You manage punch lists and close-out, so we hand over a plant that works from day one.

What makes this role specific

With us, you are not building for a client you will never see again. We operate the plants ourselves afterwards, and our own colleagues will live with what you build for many years. You succeed in this role when you have led the next builds safely to completion, made the right decisions along the way, kept the budget on track, and made both the collaboration and the construction succeed.

We imagine that you:

• have a technical education, e.g. as a mechanical engineer, or a trade background (civil, mechanical or electrical) with hands-on experience

• have at least 5 years' experience as a site manager on industrial, energy, utility or process projects

• know civil, mechanical and electrical works and the health and safety rules on a construction site

• speak and write English and either Danish or German

Experience in biogas or anaerobic digestion is an advantage, but not a requirement. It is also an advantage if you hold a Danish construction safety coordinator certificate (AMK-B), first aid, knowledge of ATEX zones, or experience with welding coordination.

As a person, you are visible on site and make decisions when they need to be made. You can push back on a contractor and still have a good working relationship the next day.

We offer

A central role in a growing company, where you are involved from ground-breaking until the plant is running. You get a competitive salary, either mileage at the official Danish rates or a company van, accommodation and per diem on projects, pension and health insurance, ongoing training and support for relevant certifications. The position is full-time, starting 1 February or 1 March 2027.

About Bigadan

We develop, build, operate and own biogas plants and work across the entire value chain, from sourcing organic residues to producing energy, biogenic CO₂ and biofertiliser. We are around 200 colleagues and have built more than 40 biogas plants in Denmark and abroad.

Every day, we turn manure, food waste and other organic residues into products of value for the energy, agriculture and industrial sectors. This supports security of supply, makes better use of resources and returns nutrients to the soil.

Interested?

The application deadline is Wednesday 30 December 2026. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your application and CV as soon as possible. If you have questions, please contact Head of Projects Luke Morris on +45 3073 6851 or lm@bigadan.dk.

Martini House søger en dygtig kok til vores køkkenteam.

At holde din station organiseret, ren og velforsynet

• 
At følge opskrifter og sikre ensartet kvalitet på menuen

• 
At planlægge dine opgaver og kommunikere tydeligt med resten af køkkenteamet

At hjælpe til på andre områder i køkkenet efter behov

• 
Har erfaring fra køkken, herunder erfaring med service

Er god til prep og organisering

Har blik for detaljer og er stolt af kvaliteten i dit arbejde

Tager initiativ og kan arbejde selvstændigt

• 
Previous kitchen experience, including experience on the line

• 
Good preparation and organizational skills

• 
A steady, efficient approach during busy service

• 
Attention to detail and pride in the quality of your work

• 
Reliability and a positive, team-focused attitude

Martini House is a modern Italian-American restaurant on Brigadevej in Amager, focused on warm hospitality, great ingredients, and food that feels classic in the best way possible.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a temporary job with the opportunity to get plenty of hours? Then this could be the right opportunity for you!

 Fredericia – Temporary Position – Evening & Night Shifts

We are currently looking for reliable and flexible temps to support one of our clients in Fredericia. The company expects to become busier over the coming weeks, which means there may be many shifts available.

During busy periods, there may be opportunities to work around 37 hours per week. However, as the number of shifts depends on the company's workload, we cannot guarantee a specific number of hours.

 

Your tasks will include:

• 
Sorting and handling parcels and letters

• 
Handling and placing shipments correctly

• 
Lifting and moving heavier parcels

• 
General warehouse and production tasks

• 
Helping to ensure that the daily work runs smoothly

The job involves physical work and regular heavy lifting, so you should be comfortable with an active working day.

 

Working hours:

There are shifts available on both weekdays and weekends.

The expected shifts are:

• 
Evening shift: approx. 16:00-22:30

• 
Night shift: approx. 23:00-07:00 

Please note that working hours may vary depending on the company's workload. You may therefore occasionally be asked to start earlier or stay longer than the scheduled shift.

We are looking for someone who is flexible and able to adjust to changing working hours when there is extra work.

 

We expect that you:

• 
Are reliable and punctual

• 
Are comfortable with physical work and heavy lifting

• 
Are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

• 
Can work independently and take responsibility

• 
Are flexible regarding working hours and shifts

• 
Have safety shoes

• 
Speak and understand either Danish or English

 

We offer:

• 
The opportunity for recurring shifts and ongoing work

• 
Good opportunities for more hours as the workload increases

• 
A dynamic and active workplace

• 
Salary and employment conditions in accordance with the applicable collective agreement
